sourceBinding: SHA supplied by caller; source digest checked before/after, archive identity must be verified separately by runner
strictActivation: local benchmark test-fixture dependency; actual signed backup/proof, not a product CLI
timing: Each read wall is independent. Instrumented stage/adapter/CH times are cumulative and nested: never sum into wall.
remainingKindMeaning: Real completed reducer publications; zero rows explicitly reported, not synthetic carry data.

metrics.incrementalFallbackMeaning: fixed allowlisted reason counters, cumulative observed reason events (feature_disabled/not_strict are full-plan reasons, not actual fallbacks); not unique people or IDs; arbitrary text rejected
metrics.adapterMeaning: fixed store label; other includes unlabelled observations; original operation/stage aggregate remains unchanged
metrics.chPhaseMeaning: disjoint classification of the SAME ch_transport leaf events; never add phase view to adapter/stage view. calls=timed attempts; requests=actual fetch dispatches only when instrumented; null means unmeasured
metrics.pagePathLookupMeaning: page_path_lookup is the actual path-lookup SQL leaf elapsed duration nested in session_build_wall; calls count queries, lookupInputRows/lookupReturnedRows count cumulative inputs/returned rows including repeats, not unique events. Never sum this leaf with inclusive build wall.
metrics.incrementalCountMeaning: dirtyVisitors/reusedSessions/reusedOwnerHeads/rebuiltSessions/producedEffectRows/hydratedEffectRows/inputEvents are cumulative observed counts across plan invocations, including repeat work; not distinct people or unique effects. fullPlans/deltaPlans/fallbackPlans are emitted numeric plan indicators; unmeasured counts remain null. Only separately allowlisted fallback reason codes are emitted, never arbitrary text or identity
metrics.byteMeaning: requestBodyBytes=UTF8 POST body; responseBodyBytes=actual body chunks read, including partial failure; queryTextBytes=UTF8 SQL only, not parameters. Excludes URLs, headers, compression, TLS and network wire overhead. bytes retains historical adapter-specific definition; do not sum it with new byte fields
